question: What site, publication, count, context, later-find, custody and digital-access evidence can be recovered for the Pakistan and Afghanistan sites in the October 2026 census batch?
outcome: Compiled 33 in-scope site rows from 90 source records and 126 live-web queries. Seven sites have numeric source count claims, with non-comparable count units preserved. The local snapshot matches 27 rows with 4,832 faces, 3,903 object families and 3,634 distinct CISI identifiers.
challenge: Most published totals are not class-resolved or use different units; several site bibliographies, CISI ranges and artifact-level metadata remain unverified. Local labels also include India-side sites and one ambiguous homonym.
remedy: Preserved source-specific counts and their units, linked each site to query and source records, separated out-of-scope India labels and marked unresolved bibliography, context, custody and rights fields explicitly.
retry_when: A complete digitized CISI set, newly accessible excavation catalogues, or object-level institutional inventories allow page-level count and metadata reconciliation.
